messages:
andrea b: opened a PR reconciling the docs examples with the billing tiers. noticed an off-by-one between dashboard labels and the CSV used in examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4901 :eyes:

mike r: can you show the tiny sample that mismatches? i want to reproduce quickly.

andrea b: sure — sample in the PR:
```
# usage.csv
user,requests
acct-a,999
acct-b,1000
acct-c,10000
```
 dashboard example groups acct-c into "Tier 2 (1k-10k)" but the billing export treats 10k as start of Tier 3.

cheng li: our metering pipeline uses half-open intervals [min, max). docs should call this out. i'll change wording in tiering.md and add a tiny table.

sam_k: also found the SDK snippet in /snippets/metering/v6 uses header `X-Redwood-Quota: 1000` without units. i'll update with an inline comment `# requests` and add a curl + js example.

mike r: UX note: keep readable labels like "1k-10k" on panels but add parenthetical precise bounds e.g. "1k-10k (1,0000-9,999]?)" wait that's confusing. maybe tooltip is better.

andrea b: agreed — tooltip for precise semantics. marie, can you own the Grafana tooltip?

marie: yep, i'll add text: "Labels are rounded for readability. Actual intervals are half-open: [min, max)." will push panel-annotation PR.

cheng li: pushed docs change: stated explicitly: "Intervals are half-open: [min, max). Values equal to max belong to the next tier." updated examples and recalculated the sample mapping.

sam_k: pushed SDK snippet update: includes JS example and curl. snippet shows header with units and clarifies that the SDK calculator uses half-open intervals. code:```js
// JS sample
await client.post('/v1/metering/calc', { headers: { 'X-Redwood-Quota': '1000 (requests)' }, body: { user: 'acct-c', requests: 10000 } });
```

mike r: i opened panel PR to add tooltip and a small note in the panel description. also added a checksum for the public CSV link as marie requested.

andrea b: small l10n note: the migration guide linked to an internal CSV; i've swapped it for the public export: https://docs.redwood.ai/public/billing-tiers.csv — can someone verify before i merge?

mike r: verified link reachable. i'll add an sha256 hash line in the docs so translators can sanity-check.

marie: panel PR landed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4905 — tooltip text matches.

cheng li: ran quick script against the sample rows; now dashboard examples, SDK snippet output, and billing CSV map to the same tiers. no mismatches.

andrea b: thanks — final checklist in the PR description: 1) docs: half-open interval note, 2) SDK snippet: units + examples, 3) panel: tooltip + annotation, 4) migration guide: public CSV + checksum, 5) l10n ping. i'll merge once CI and l10n confirm. :thumbsup:
